title: The area function F(x) = ∫₁^{3x} ln t dt
caption: F(x) = 3x ln(3x) − 3x + 1 is the area under ln t from 1 to 3x. Its slope at each x is 3 ln(3x), the height of the integrand at 3x times the rate 3 at which 3x moves: F′ is the dashed curve.
alt: The curve F(x) = 3x ln 3x − 3x + 1, which is zero at x = 1/3, rising steeply, with the curve 3 ln(3x) for its gradient; the slopes match at x = 0.5, 1 and 2.
description: F(x) is the area under ln t between t = 1 and t = 3x.
By part 1 with the chain rule, F′(x) = ln(3x) × 3 = 3 ln(3x).
At x = 1/3 the limits coincide, so F = 0 there.

checks.name: the slope of F at x = 0.5 is 3 ln(3x) = 1.216
the slope of F at x = 1 is 3 ln(3x) = 3.296
the slope of F at x = 2 is 3 ln(3x) = 5.375
